brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.requirement: A base that holds removable bins for small parts (bins drop into the base and can be lifted out)
requirements.evidence: Two full-depth 2-compartment bins (bin:0,0,0 and bin:1,0,0) sit in cells of the base pieces. They are seated tray bins, but each cell is capped by a top cover (needed for the handle triangle), so a bin must be uncovered before it can be lifted out. The bins are not fixed by joint bolts; the removability was not physically verified.
drawer:0#0,1#cut (style s) on the cut face of piece half-n at (0,1), with the drawer_front open to the cut face. Configurator accepted it; mesh clear.
handle:0,0,0;top, seated on the triangle of three top covers (cover at (0,0), (1,0), (0,1)) with its inserts; accepted by the configurator with meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Portable: a compact build that stays small enough to carry
requirements.evidence: 15 parts across three base cells on one level, under the 30-part limit. Size was not measured for carrying weight; no material or load check is possible here.

finish.summary: Built a three-cell organizer: full base at (0,0), full base at (1,0), and a north half base at (0,1) carrying a drawer on its cut face. Two 2-compartment bins sit in the first two cells. The three top covers form the triangle a carry handle needs, and the handle is seated on them. Joint bolts lock the pieces together (no LOOSE_BODY). check_build reports meshClash clear and no errors; only info-level OPEN_CAP_FACE remains. Caveat: the top covers close the bin cells, so bins are removable only after the cover is lifted, and I could not confirm that by physical test. Portability and material suitability are not checkable here.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
